title: LLM-Assisted Workflow for Structural Difference Visualization in Evolving Software Requirements
summary: This paper presents an LLM-assisted workflow for visualizing structural differences in evolving software require- ments. Implemented in the OntologyWeb environment, the work- flow represents baseline and current requirements as triple-based semantic graphs and supports side-by-side comparison of curated graph snapshots. The comparison view aligns matched entities and uses visual encoding to highlight structural changes.
